authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10984 *lavaṇḍa explicitly gives Hindi lauṇḍā boy and Kumaoni lauṛo without a nasal. Survey lauḍa/lauḍiya/loɳɖa/laura fit this family, retaining ordinary feminine and son/boy distinctions. Exact survey form lauḍa is preserved; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
